description: Attester endorsement vectors for the lnbtc settlement claim, as proposed on x402-foundation/x402#1195. The endorsement is an optional member of the attester's key registry entry; it does not change the claim or claim_id.
message_rule: msg = UTF8(JCS({"domain": "x402:lnbtc:attester-endorsement:v1", "node_id": payee_endorsement.node_id, "attester": {kid, kty, crv, x} of the registry entry})). The verifier rebuilds msg from the entry; it never takes a message supplied alongside the signature.
signature_format: ln-signmessage: zbase32(SigRec) where SigRec = (31 + recovery_id) || 64-byte compact secp256k1 signature over SHA256(SHA256("Lightning Signed Message:" || msg)). Single-hash signatures are invalid. Signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic.

states.ENDORSEMENT_VERIFIED: the signature recovers node_id, and node_id equals the payee of the claim's payment_request
states.ENDORSEMENT_OTHER_NODE: the signature recovers node_id, but node_id is not the payee; the verifier reports node_id with this state, and only with this state
states.ENDORSEMENT_NOT_PRESENT: the registry entry has no payee_endorsement
states.ENDORSEMENT_INVALID: payee_endorsement is present but does not verify; a fact about the registry entry, never reported as NOT_PRESENT

invoice_payee_source: payee recovered from claim.payment_request in lnbtc-settlement-v1.json (secp256k1 private key 0x00..01)

cases.name: invalid_node_id_swapped
cases.description: The verified case's signature with node_id replaced by the 0x00..02 node. The verifier rebuilds msg with the claimed node_id, so the signature recovers a key that is not node_id.
